test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

The bride has an __exquisite__ face.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Beautiful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"exquisite"** refers to something that is extremely beautiful, delicate, or finely crafted. (अति सुंदर, उत्कृष्ट)

 
 
• **Example:** The artist created an exquisite sculpture that mesmerized everyone.
 
 
 
• **"Beautiful"** means something that is pleasing to the senses or mind, often used to describe physical or aesthetic charm. (सुंदर)
 
 
• **Example:** The garden was filled with beautiful flowers in vibrant colors.
 
 
 
• Hence, "exquisite" is synonymous with "beautiful."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Beautiful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Average** (औसत): Something that is ordinary or not exceptional.

 
 
• **Example:** His performance in the test was average, neither outstanding nor poor.
 
 
 
• **Plain** (साधारण): Something simple or ordinary, lacking decoration or beauty.
 
 
• **Example:** She prefers plain clothes over fancy outfits.
 
 
 
• **Ugly** (बदसूरत): Something that is unpleasant in appearance or unattractive.
 
 
• **Example:** The building looked ugly due to its poor maintenance.
 
 

183:Te17,

योग्य उत्तर आहे: **Beautiful (सुंदर)**.
